mechanics.title: Bottling XP
mechanics.description: Sneak + right-click an empty bottle. Default config: damage 1 half-heart (damageOnCreation true, halfHeartDamageAmount 1), consumes 10 raw XP per bottle (rawXpConsumedOnCreation, range 0-100).

commands_and_keybinds: Sneak + right-click with an empty bottle
getting_started: Hold a glass bottle, crouch and right-click.
editor_notes: Config values are mod defaults; no pack override found. Produces the vanilla Bottle o' Enchanting.
name: Bottle Your Xp
summary: Sneak and right-click with an empty glass bottle to turn your own experience into a Bottle o' Enchanting. By default it costs 10 raw XP and hurts you slightly.
